home.heroTitle: Turn what you don't need into what someone needs
home.heroLede: Point your camera at items you no longer use. Donation AI identifies them, finds the NGO that needs them most, and tracks every step until they arrive.
home.aiDetectionDesc: Our AI identified the items in your image. Review and confirm before continuing.
home.howItWorksTitle: From your closet to someone's doorstep
home.howItWorksDesc: Four steps connect what you no longer need with the people who need it most.
home.step1Desc: Take a photo of the items you want to donate, or upload one from your gallery.
home.step2Desc: Our model detects each item and scores its confidence, so nothing gets added by mistake.
home.step3Desc: Items are matched to nearby NGOs based on need, priority, and distance.
home.step4Desc: Follow your donation from pickup to delivery, and see who it reached.
home.detectionTitle: When the AI isn't sure, you decide
home.detectionDesc: Every detected item is scored, not just accepted. That score changes what happens next — so uncertainty is visible, not hidden.
home.addedAutoDesc: High-confidence detections go straight into your donation cart.
home.flaggedCheckDesc: Mid-confidence items are added, but we ask you to confirm before submitting.
home.leftDecideDesc: Low-confidence items aren't auto-added — you choose whether to include them.
home.matchTitle: See exactly why an NGO was matched
home.matchDesc: Instead of a single "matched" label, every match shows the factors behind it — item fit, distance, and how urgent the need is. It's the fastest way to earn trust from donors and NGOs alike.
home.matchPoint1: Ranking factors shown in plain language, not a score alone
home.matchPoint2: Priority need and expiry dates kept visible, not buried
home.matchPoint3: Same match card on donor and NGO dashboards
home.pipelineTitle: Track a donation from submission to delivery
home.pipelineDesc: The same status stepper appears on both donor and NGO dashboards, so nobody is guessing where things stand.
home.forDonorsDesc: Turn a five-minute photo into a donation you can track from pickup to delivery.
home.forNgosDesc: List what you need, set priority, and receive matches without chasing donors.
home.footerNewsletter: Get news on new NGO partners and product updates.
home.footerTech: Technology that turns giving into impact.
